title: 第一卷第15章 匕见报仇伊始第一卷第16章 愤怒顾天的灵牌
content_zh:
若是平日。
以顾寒的灵觉，自然能提早发现来人。
只不过此时他正值破境，心神紧绷之下，感知自然比先前弱了不少。
“少爷！”
阿傻神情一紧。
“他们……”
“是他！”
听到其中那道再熟悉不过的声音，顾寒心中恨意大起！
“顾成！”
恨意交织下。
那日被陷害的情景再次浮现在脑海中！
当日，他被人暗中偷袭，陷入昏迷，等醒过来时，便发现已经发狂的顾天冲向自己，心口上，赫然插着一把剑！
他的剑！
彼时。
他刚要接近顾天。
却是被重伤垂死，神志不清的顾天一掌劈在肩头。
等他再次清醒过来，除了地上那把染血的长剑之外，再没了顾天的踪影，而他的衣襟内，也多了一枚金印，耳边还残留着顾天交代他绝对不能贸然参悟金印的话。
紧接着。
他就被赶来的顾长众人安上了弑父的罪名。
废除根基修为！

逐出顾家！
他自然清楚，从头到尾，这件事的始作俑者都是顾长那几人，只是以他那时的修为，面对数名通窍境高手，根本没有丝毫的反抗能力。
“义父！”
想到十七年来，顾天对他的种种，他眼睛瞬间变得一片血红！
凶手……
就在眼前！
“少爷……”
就连阿傻，也觉得此时的顾寒有些吓人。
“阿傻！”
顾寒转过身，强保持心中的最后一丝理智。
“别出去，等我回来！”
“少爷。”
阿傻有点想哭。
“你……你可别死呀……”
“死的，是他们！”
顾寒缓缓起身，轻轻摸了摸腰间的一只储物袋。
里面……
装着那杆火云枪！
轰！
情绪激荡之下，他体内灵力如翻江倒海，瞬间突破了最后的屏障，将他推入了开脉七重境！
content_en:
If it is a normal day.
With Gu Han's spiritual sense, he would naturally be able to detect the visitor in advance.
It's just that he was breaking through the realm at this time, and with his mind tense, his perception was naturally much weaker than before.
"Master!"
Ah Sha looked tense.
"They..."
"It's him!"
Hearing the all-too-familiar voice among them, Gu Han felt a surge of hatred in his heart!
"Gu Cheng!"
Hate mixed together.
The scene of being framed that day came to mind again!
That day, he was secretly attacked and fell into a coma. When he woke up, he found that a frantic Gu Tian was rushing toward him, with a sword stuck in his heart!
His sword!
At that time.
He was just about to approach Gu Tian.
But Gu Tian, ​​who was seriously injured and dying, and unconscious, was struck on the shoulder with a palm.
When he woke up again, except for the blood-stained long sword on the ground, there was no trace of Gu Tian. There was also a gold seal in his lapel, and Gu Tian's words that he must not rashly comprehend the gold seal still lingered in his ears.
Immediately afterwards.
He was charged with patricide by the people who came over, Chief Gu.
Abolish the basic cultivation!
Expelled from the Gu family!
He naturally knew that from beginning to end, the initiators of this matter were Gu Chang and the others. However, with his cultivation at that time, he had no ability to resist at all when faced with several masters of the Aperture Realm.
"Father!"
Thinking of what Gu Tian had done to him over the past seventeen years, his eyes instantly turned blood red!
The murderer...
Right before your eyes!
"Master..."
Even Ah Sha felt that Gu Han was a bit scary at this time.
"Silly!"
Gu Han turned around and tried to maintain the last trace of reason in his heart.
"Don't go out, wait until I come back!"
"Master."
Asha wanted to cry a little bit.
"You...don't die..."
"It's them who are dead!"
Gu Han stood up slowly and gently touched a storage bag on his waist.
inside...
Equipped with that fire cloud gun!
boom!
Under the agitation of emotions, the spiritual power in his body surged like a river, instantly breaking through the last barrier and pushing him into the seventh level of opening the pulse!
